title: IOC consensus statement on Relative Energy Deficiency in Sport (REDs)
claims: REDs describes a syndrome of health and performance effects associated with low energy availability.
The 2023 IOC consensus updated the earlier female athlete triad framework and applies to both male and female athletes.
REDs can affect multiple body systems, including endocrine, bone, metabolic and psychological health, and requires clinical assessment.
